title: Skull-base bones and dural model relationships
author: NeuroImage teaching workspace
objective: Identify the named source models, trace their supplied extents and compare spatial relationships from several views.

scenes.title: Sphenoid bone
scenes.prompt: Inspect the sphenoid model with the neighboring temporal and ethmoid models. Identify the selected source object and describe its relationship to the visible context.
scenes.note: Sphenoid bone. This view retains the source author's named geometry, object extent and native XYZ coordinates. Source definitions and processing details accompany the model.
